# Error code reference

Every failure is `{ok=false,error=BloxError}` with required kind, code, message, endpoint and attempts.
HTTP status is optional. Bodies are redacted; messages are not a parsing contract.
Switch on kind for cross-service behavior; code identifies a specific diagnostic.

## SDK fallback codes

| Code | Kind |
|---|---|
| `sdk_unauthorized` | `Unauthorized` |
| `sdk_forbidden` | `Forbidden` |
| `sdk_not_found` | `NotFound` |
| `sdk_conflict` | `Conflict` |
| `sdk_validation` | `Validation` |
| `sdk_rate_limited` | `RateLimited` |
| `sdk_server` | `Server` |
| `sdk_network` | `Network` |
| `sdk_timeout` | `Timeout` |
| `sdk_circuit_open` | `CircuitOpen` |
| `sdk_cancelled` | `Cancelled` |
| `sdk_local` | `Local` |

Local queue saturation is RateLimited / sdk_rate_limited with no HTTP status. Budget waits may instead
reach Timeout. Retry only eligible keyed/idempotent operations within the original deadline.
Unauthorized/Forbidden need credential/grant correction; Validation needs input correction; Conflict
needs authoritative reload/reconciliation, not a fresh key that duplicates an uncertain write.

API keys can be restricted in the portal. `scope_denied` (403, Forbidden) means the key may not use that field, namespace or route: change the key scope, do not retry. `key_rate_limited` (429, RateLimited) means the key hit its own per-second or daily limit: `error.retryAfterSeconds` carries Retry-After, idempotent calls wait that long automatically within their deadline, and a daily limit can be hours long, so back off instead of looping.

## Environment codes (dev and prod)

Retry follows the HTTP kind, as for every other code: none of these is retried automatically, and none succeeds on a plain retry.

| Code | Where | Kind | Retry | Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dev_limit_exceeded` | Fields definitions or Config entries, status 409 | `Conflict` | no | The dev environment is over its small cap (100 definitions, 200 entries per namespace); remove something in dev or reset dev in the portal |
| `environment_mismatch` | any service, status 403 | `Forbidden` | no | The request named an environment that is not the key's own; the SDK never sends one, so this means a proxy or custom header |
| `environment_invalid` | portal routes, status 400 | `Validation` | no | The environment header was neither `dev` nor `prod` (portal and HTTP only) |
| `environment_required` | portal routes, status 400 | `Validation` | no | The environment header is missing (portal and HTTP only) |
| `prod_key_in_studio` | `BloxSDK.new`, local, raised as an error, no request is made | none (assertion) | no | Use a `bsd_` key in Studio, or pass `allowProdInStudio = true` deliberately; see [dev and prod](ENVIRONMENTS.md) |

Recognized codes are normalized to lowercase snake_case across all services (including Auth).
Backend error text and unknown backend codes are never copied; unknown codes use the SDK fallback.

## Item list codes

| Code | Where | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| `unknown_member` | Fields write | The name is not in the item list (`members` lists up to 20); fix the name or add the member |
| `member_retired` | Fields write | Only active members can be granted or replaced; use `unretireMember` or another member |
| `member_limit` | Fields write | The result would exceed the field `maxMembers`; revoke first |
| `invalid_member_name` / `invalid_bitmap` | Fields write | Malformed name, or a `SET` value that is not canonical |
| `enum_source_unavailable` | Fields write, status 503 | The item list has not loaded yet; retry (`usable`, `has` and `members` ask the server meanwhile) |
| `source_immutable` | Fields definition | A field keeps its item list; define a new field |
| `member_in_use` | Config removal, status 409 | Players hold the member; `error.holders` has counts and sample ids. Retire it instead |
| `holder_check_unavailable` | Config removal, status 503 | The holder check could not answer; retry later or retire |
| `kind_immutable`, `invalid_member`, `bit_immutable`, `bit_taken`, `rollback_invalid` | Config admin | The write is not a valid item list change; see [item lists](ITEM-LISTS.md) |

See [fault tolerance](FAULT-TOLERANCE.md), [authentication](AUTH.md), [Fields](FIELDS.md),
[dev and prod](ENVIRONMENTS.md), [item lists](ITEM-LISTS.md), [rotations](ROTATIONS.md), and [matchmaking](MATCHMAKING.md) for service-specific recovery.
